purpose: Fail-closed technical-art gate for correcting the frozen v3 low_aim camera/composition failure without changing visual acceptance or claiming new evidence.

break_ppm.technical_art_observation: Table, balls, rails, venue and authored light response are visible under the same frozen formal asset package.

low_aim_ppm.technical_art_observation: The world frame is effectively black; only the bottom-left HUD bar and a few bottom-edge pixels remain visible.

independent_technical_art_attribution.primary_cause: The v3 low_aim recipe applies relative orbit and zoom to the default Elevated camera before toggle_aim. The resulting transition start is above the authored table lamp. toggle_aim starts, but does not complete, the transition to AimPlayer/PlayerLow before the immediate screenshot, so the formal frame is captured from the occluded high start pose.
causal_chain: orbit_camera pitch_delta=+0.40 and zoom_camera delta=-38 produce about 64.918 degrees and 182 cm at the transition start.
The computed v3 low_aim start eye is 241.322 cm high, above the lamp reference plane at 221.484 cm while its view ray crosses the lamp footprint.
toggle_aim begins an AimPlayer/PlayerLow transition with transition alpha zero.
No camera-time step or immediate semantic snap occurs before get_state and screenshot.
The world is occluded while the screen-space HUD remains visible.

reasons_excluded.asset_or_lighting: break renders the same frozen asset package and lighting, and low_aim still renders its HUD, so assets, lighting and renderer execution are not the primary failure.
reasons_excluded.interest_region: low_aim is globally absent outside the ROI as well; moving or weakening the ROI would hide a black-world failure rather than repair composition.

every_scene_camera_rule.reason: Every scene has a named semantic pose; low_aim snaps after toggle_aim, while a later intentional shot/replay transition in another scene must settle and be verified before capture.
